matches.title: Swarmer fallen solo | No Accelerator, Ranger, Turret, or Minigunner
matches.snippet: That's right, Executioner is all you need for hidden detection, and while the triumph screen does hide the one in the top left corner, I only needed three maxed Executioners, and I guess a max Medic too, but it contributed basically nothing for damage. Executioner was my early game after tanking first 4 waves, although I'm pretty confident you can place it sooner and be fine in terms of farming for level 4 by wave 13. Why the Executioner is so efficient is because of the new targeting settings, specifically farthest, although last can also work pretty well on long straight paths if you have towers to cover leaked enemies (including hiddens), and even random can work somewhat well. This works because the Executioner hitting something with an axe only counts as a bounce once it has hit it's intended target at least once, then everything past that will be a bounce, or extra hit on either the target or other enemy, then return to the tower after using up all bounces. The hitbox of the axe is always active from the moment it is thrown though, so by setting the targeting to farthest or last and making sure the tower is placed a bit close to a straight path, you can set it up so it goes for a target pretty far from it where the axe will hit many other enemies while doing so without needing to return. matches.title: Solo Molten without Farm or Cowboy.

matches.title: making my solo fallen run more efficient
matches.snippet: My current solo fallen loadout is g cowboy, dj, engi, mortar and g crook. this guarantees a win on abaondoned city and u-turn (i don't even have to micro on u-turn), but when i tried grass isle things started getting harder. i barely beat the fallen king and a fallen hero leaked and nearly killed me. to me this feels very unreliable. Basically this is what i do: -Place 6 lvl 2 cowboys one by one. -Get 3 lvl 2 g crooks. -Get 1 lvl 2 g crook to lvl 3 and place 2 more lvl 2 g crooks. -Place a lvl 3 dj -Place 6 more lvl 2 g cowboys -Get all g crooks to lvl 3 -Get 6 cowboys to lvl 4 -Place 6 lvl 3 engis and 5 lvl 2 mortars (in either order) -Max dj -Get engis to lvl 5 and mortars to lvl 4 (again in either order) -Max engis -Max mortars -Max g crooks -Max g cowboys -Wait for the next 3 waves until wave 40 -Micro engis if fallen king goes out of range. Like i said, this can work but feels unreliable to me. I have heard some people say they use merc base instead of g crook but i don't really know how that would be done cuz merc base doesn't have reliable hidden detection till lvl 3 which costs 12k in total. I think most people use g cowboy for hidden detection but dealing with the fallens right after that is hard too. Also i do have biologist but i find that waves 19 and 31 are near impossible to pull off with the biologist. it makes the final wave easy though. Some help would be appre

matches.title: my solo/speedrun loadout rn
matches.snippet: Well, this loadout is a basically free win for molten(not sure for fallen tho, also I don't want people shout at me that ranger is better than accel). How it works: Commander and DJ for support Pursuit for early game(ik its stupid) Accel for wave 13 to late game Farm for money to upgrade everything Steps: Don't farm at wave 1-6. Instead get a lvl 2 pursuit. Then at wave 9 or 10 upgrade pursuit to lvl 3. You will continue farm until four farms are lvl 3. Then when wave 13 strike place accel immediately. Then upgrade to lvl 2. Make sure u have a lvl 2 accel when on wave 15. Continue farm until 2 farms are maxed. Then place a dj and max a dj as well upgrade accel to lvl 4. When wave 22 comes, get one more accel suggestively lvl 3. Then max all farms and spam lvl 4 accel. Put a commander as well. Then max them one by one(accel). At wave 37 u would probably maxed all accel so spam lvl 5 pursuit. Boom you got an easy victory for solo molten. Do note that this is for those who had both pursuit and accel. my solo/speedrun loadout rn

matches.title: What's the meta Loadout in TDS?
matches.snippet: Its hard to make a meta Loadout considering all modes(e.g. Normal, Hardcore, events, Pizza Party, etc.), but this is the meta Loadout I use(and yes I grinded for engineer no joke, I learned my lesson about shitposting for the pain to grind for Engineer): Engineer. This is the DPS game choice, the backbone of this meta Loadout. Does 2700(450 DPS * 6 Placement limit) DPS in total and that can kill Fallen King in around a minute if you do the math. Although it's Sentries can't deal with hiddens and can't get buffed by DJ and Commander, the gas prices get cheaper and Engineers damage is good enough to kill a shadow boss. It was my idiot ness earlier for saying engineer can't kill a shadow boss. If used properly shadow boss isn't a big deal. Farm. This is the eco choice. Always use farm over cowboy for income generation. I mean yeah Golden Cowboy has shown to make more money than farm, but it depends on the enemies coming. In badlands, it is rich, but in Molten mode, it's poor. At least with farm you don't have to worry about the enemy health for cash. DJ. This is the choice for support. The problem with Commander is Engineer's Sentries, our main DPS, can't be buffed by him. However the gas prices can be cheaper with DJ. matches.title: SOLO FALLEN STRAT. LVL 50 OR BELOW AND EASY
matches.snippet: This strategy/loadout/map is commonly used by many lower level players with not good towers to easily solo fallen. Towers: Farm [ECO] DJ [SUPPORT] Commander [SUPPORT] Pyromancer [DEFENSE MELTING/EARLY GAME] Minigunner [LATE GAME SPAM] Map: Crossroads The strategy is fairly simple to where there is no truly best way of doing it. Simply save for pyromancer and get it where the path loops, on one of the corners. Then get some level 2 farms and you should be able to get a lvl 2 pyromancer and a lvl 0 minigunner for wave 10. Freezer?) matches.title: solo molten speedrun strat(use this for molten grinding)
matches.snippet: Loadout: toxic gunner, accelerator, commander, dj, farm Wave 0: get a toxic gunner lvl 1 at the front of the map(can be any map that isnt too short or two pathed) Wave 1-4: get 3 farms lvl 1, then get toxic to lvl 2 Wave 5-7: get another lvl 1 farm, then get all farms to lvl 2 Wave 7-10: get another toxic gunner lvl 1 next to the first one, then save for an accelerator and upgrade it to lvl 2 Wave 11-13: get all farms lvl 2, then get accel to lvl 3 Wave 14-16: get all farms lvl 3 Wave 17-19: get two more accels lvl 3 Wave 20-22: get a dj lvl 3, then get 3 lvl 2 commanders and coa chain Wave 24-27: get 5 more lvl 3 accels Wave 28-33: max dj then max farms Wave 34-38: max all accels(upgrade them straight to lvl 5 each) Wave 38-40: max toxic gunners and commanders, on the last wave selling farms is optional but if you do it you have more money to spam toxics until molten boss is ded solo molten speedrun strat(use this for molten grinding)

matches.title: Best Solo Molten Loadout (in my opinion)
matches.snippet: DJ: Reducing costs of upgrades to make max accelerator possible and increasing range. Commander: Increasing fire rate and temporarily give towers 2x fire rate using Call of Arms. Farm: Make more money each wave. Accelerator: The main zombie buster. Pursuit: The early game tower. Only upgrade to level 3 before turning to accelerator. Strategy: Wait two waves until you can spawn pursuit, upgrade to lvl 1 and farm until you have almost 8 lvl 2 farms. Upgrade pursuit to lvl 3 and farm until you have at least one lvl 3 farm and the rest lvl 2. Save for accelerator and get it to lvl 3 whilst farming. Get more accelerators, put DJ and commander and max them, max the farms, max the accelerators and put max level pursuits. Sell the farms when the Molten Boss comes to easily get max pursuits. Best Solo Molten Loadout (in my opinion)
